[[EXPERIMENT_TITLE]] - ÄKTA Chromatography Run Report

1. Experiment Information

Experiment ID: [[EXPERIMENT_ID]]

Process ID: [[PROCESS_ID]]

Report Generated: [[REPORT_DATE]]

2. Start & End Date

Start Date: [[EXPERIMENT_DATE]]

End Date: [[REPORT_DATE]]

3. Methods

3.1 Automated Workflow Description
  1. Manual Sample Loading (Utility — Pause):
    • The system was paused with the instruction: "Manually fill sample loop".
    • The operator manually filled the ÄKTA sample loop with the prepared sample before continuing the run.
  2. Chromatography Run (ÄKTA Pure — Run Protocol):
    • The ÄKTA Pure system was started and the pre-configured method was executed.
    • Sample monitoring signals recorded during the run:
      • UV signal: uv1
      • Conductivity signal: cond
    • Sampling interval for recording process data: 1 s.
3.2 Run Parameters
Parameter Placeholder Description
Process ID [[PROCESS_ID]] Unique identifier of the chromatography process.
CIP Duration [[CIP_DURATION]] Total duration of the main CIP phase (e.g. min).
CIP 3 Duration [[CIP_3_DURATION]] Duration of CIP phase 3.
CIP 4 Duration [[CIP_4_DURATION]] Duration of CIP phase 4.
CIP 5 Duration [[CIP_5_DURATION]] Duration of CIP phase 5.
Wash Duration [[WASH_DURATION]] Total duration of the wash phase.
Wash Flow Rate [[WASH_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during the wash phase (e.g. mL/min).
CIP 2 Hold Duration [[CIP_2_HOLD_DURATION]] Hold duration during CIP phase 2.
Load/Inject Duration [[LOAD_INJECT_DURATION]] Total time for sample loading/injection.
Load/Inject Flow Rate [[LOAD_INJECT_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during loading/injection (e.g. mL/min).
Equilibration Duration [[EQUILIBRATION_DURATION]] Time used to equilibrate the column.
Equilibration Flow Rate [[EQUILIBRATION_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during column equilibration (e.g. mL/min).
Elution Gradient Duration [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_DURATION]] Total duration of the elution gradient.
Elution Gradient Start (%B) [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_START]] Starting percentage of buffer B in the gradient.
Elution Gradient End (%B) [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_END]] Final percentage of buffer B in the gradient.
